source: BEST EFFORT -- English labels assembled from general community terminology for the same ten roulette ids as data/roulettes/cn.json. Not sourced from an authoritative GLOBAL ContentRoulette export and not cross-checked against any GLOBAL client capture. Display data only: it never identifies a roulette and never makes a protocol profile usable.

provenance.note: Ids 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,15,17 are the mapping this project has actually observed on the wire: the 2026-09-07 capture in which the player queued each roulette in list order and the client sent 5,8,2,1,6,3,4,17 (protocol-profiles/cn/cn.2026.08.05.json, calibration.finder_request.roulette_field evidence), confirmed again on 2026-09-12 when the player named 顶级迷宫 and 满级迷宫 for the ids the software had read as 5 and 8. An earlier version of this file carried the CSV's names against the wrong ids (5, 6, 8 and 17) and labelled the player's own evening wrongly. Ids this project has not observed are absent rather than guessed; id 9 (mentor) is the one exception and comes from the same CSV. This file is presentation-only -- it never identifies a roulette on the wire and never makes a protocol profile usable.
